description: This file defines the AcmeNoopBusinessStep class which implements the LoanCOBBusinessStep interface and provides a no-operation (noop) implementation for a loan COB (Close of Business) step. It is part of the ACME specific COB processing within the Fineract loan module, mainly serving as a placeholder or demonstration that dependency injection and COB step registration works.

classes.name: AcmeNoopBusinessStep
classes.description: A noop implementation of the LoanCOBBusinessStep interface, used as a stub or placeholder COB step within the Acme loan COB process. It logs its initialization and simply returns the input Loan object.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization callback, logs the class name during bean initialization.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the COB step; in this case, it simply returns the input Loan object without modification.

methods.name: getEnumStyledName
methods.description: Returns the enum-styled identifier name for this COB step.

methods.name: getHumanReadableName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name for this COB step.
